examples.title: A Qwen2.5 model lands among other Qwen2.5 models
points: Its nearest neighbour is DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, which is also built on Qwen2.5.
Five of its 10 nearest neighbours are Qwen2.5 instruct models: 0.5B, 1.5B, 3B, Coder-7B and 7B-Instruct.
Its 10 nearest neighbours range from 0.5B to 9B parameters.

examples.title: A closed API model lands next to the highest-ability paper models
points: The page placed it by fold-in from its answers, the same way it places an upload. No encoder, head or PCA was fitted with it or with the eight other closed models.

Its four nearest neighbours are qwen3-4b, mimo-7b-rl, phi-4-mini-reasoning and Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct-2501, the four paper models with the highest ability θ. Eight of the nine closed models share the same three nearest neighbours.
Its θ is 4.4 SD above the training mean, above all 260 paper models. The highest of them, qwen3-4b, is at 2.5 SD.

examples.title: A merge lands next to models from its publisher
points: The folds group models by publisher, so this model is held out together with every other model from its publisher.
Six of its 10 nearest neighbours come from that publisher. The other four are Llama-family role-play, uncensored or instruction fine-tunes.

examples.title: An uncensored fine-tune lands next to its 7B sibling
points: The 260 paper models include no abliterated model. This example uses the closest kind in the set, a Llama-family fine-tune released as uncensored.
Its neighbours include Wizard-Vicuna-7B-Uncensored and two other uncensored fine-tunes, Uncensored-Frank 7B and 13B.

examples.title: A held-out preference-tuned model finds its base model
points: The fold-in placed it from its answers alone (bits, question text and answer text), the same way it places an upload.
Its nearest neighbour, by a clear margin, is gemma-2-9b-it, the model it was preference-tuned from.
